title: Blue Hour and Weather
author: Astrid Marchetti
blurb: Ada Montrose, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
